caption:
The video captures a calm lake in a mountain valley under a clear blue sky, with a golden-brown grassy hill sloping to the waterline. Dry shrubs and bare branches dot the hillside, while a long snow-streaked ridge with jagged peaks stretches across the far shore. Dark trees and a tiny white building sit on the right bank, and thin reeds appear in the lower-left foreground. The water mirrors the mountains, hills, and sky, filling the frame with inverted reflections.

The surface is not perfectly glassy. The reflected snow-capped ridge and brown hillside continuously shimmer and wobble, with white snow streaks bending, breaking, and re-forming from moment to moment. Reflected bare branches on the right and hill texture on the left deform subtly, consistent with gentle ripples moving across the surface rather than any change in the real objects above the water. The actual mountains, hills, sky, shoreline trees, and building hold fixed positions and shapes throughout the scene, while the mirror images change and camera framing remains essentially constant, with no noticeable pan or tilt.
